## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

- Commands run and results:
- Automated coverage added for changed behavior:

## Review

- [ ] Documentation and compatibility claims match observed behavior.
- [ ] No setup codes, QR images, credentials, raw serials or local configuration included.
- [ ] Dependency changes include license review and regenerated notices.
- [ ] Known limitations and remaining manual checks are listed.
